name: inloop
description: Stay in the loop with the code your agent writes. Before each change Claude writes a short, structured note: what it does, why, its parameters and why each new class or function exists. You read the notes live while Claude works and later as a review page, in the language you choose.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of inloop's notes and review page, as a name or a code (English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Nederlands, tr, de, nl ...). It does not depend on the language you chat in.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: What the notes hold, as tags combined with commas: summary (the point, what and why; the cheapest), review (what a reviewer needs), learn (line by line, imports, parameters, terms), decisions (trade-offs and options weighed), architecture (system-level consequences), onboarding (learn, plus where the code sits in the codebase), all (everything; the most expensive). Tag names are English in every language.

adhd.title: ADHD-friendly notes
adhd.description: on: notes put the point first, use short lines and bold key words, and explain every term, symbol and parameter with an example from the code, keeping technical terms as developers say them. It changes how notes are written, not how much they explain.
